say:1:1910337001:1.text: What took you two so long? We were about to start the renewal ceremony without you!
say:1:1910337001:1.source_cn: 你们怎么现在才来呀？再晚一点，洄游仪式就要先开始啦。

say:2:1910337002:1.text: Without us? Hey, aren't we the stars of the show today?
say:2:1910337002:1.source_cn: 你们先开始？喂，今天的主角不是咱和大个子吗？

say:3:1910337003:1.text: You two aren't the only ones. We're welcoming lots of new family members today!
say:3:1910337003:1.source_cn: 今天是洄游季开始的日子，除了你们，还要迎来很多很多其他...

say:4:1910337004:1.text: First up is the Shellglow Clan! They've got more than enough nutrients this year to bring new life to Coralia.
say:4:1910337004:1.source_cn: 看，首先是砗光家族！他们今年收集了很多养料，马上就能为...

choice_prompt:5:1910337004.text: First up is the Shellglow Clan! They've got more than enough nutrients this year to bring new life to Coralia.
choice_prompt:5:1910337004.source_cn: 看，首先是砗光家族！他们今年收集了很多养料，马上就能为塔拉萨迎来新的生命了。

say:6:1910337005:1.text: Where else? The Cradle Pool is where all new life begins!
say:6:1910337005:1.source_cn: 当然啦！这里是繁育池，所有新生命都是从这里诞生的。

say:7:1910337006:1.source_cn: 啥？！现在？立刻？在这么多人面前？！

say:8:1910337007:1.text: Yeah! It's what the renewal ceremony is all about... Wait, why are you looking at me like that?
say:8:1910337007:1.source_cn: 对啊，洄游季不就是这样吗？你们等等也要参加洄游仪式的…...

say:9:1910337011:1.source_cn: 等等、等等！咱彻底混乱了！

say:10:1910337012:1.text: What exactly are we getting ourselves into?
say:10:1910337012:1.source_cn: 洄游仪式是啥玩意儿，咱到底要参加啥？

say:11:1910337013:1.text: I thought we'd just be welcomed into the clan, have a big feast, and call it a day!
say:11:1910337013:1.source_cn: 难道不是说句话，告诉其他海裔咱是海月家的新家人，然后大...

say:12:1910337014:1.text: Huh? If you knew nothing about the renewal season, why were you so keen to stick around?
say:12:1910337014:1.source_cn: 欸？我还以为你们很了解洄游季，才想要留下参加的。

say:13:1910337015:1.text: Anyway, the ceremony's simple enough. Just watch, and you'll get the hang of it!
say:13:1910337015:1.source_cn: 不过也没关系，洄游仪式很简单的，看一次就知道该怎么做了。

say:14:1910337016:1.text: Look! The reproduction is about to begin!

say:15:1910337017:1.text: 一阵欢快的喧哗响起。你看到一位海裔抱着魔法素材，满怀欣喜地走向繁育池……
say:15:1910337017:1.source_cn: 一阵欢快的喧哗响起。你看到一位海裔抱着魔法素材，满怀欣...

choice:5:0:1.text: Whoa, whoa! Are you guys going to reproduce right here?!
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 等等！你们要在这里繁衍？！
choice:5:0:1.male: Whoa, whoa! Are you guys going to reproduce right here?!
choice:5:0:1.female: Whoa, whoa! Are you guys going to reproduce right here?!

say:17:1910337008:1.text: 也算是啦，不过要等到你们真正的家人之后才会一起庆祝。
say:17:1910337008:1.source_cn: 也算是啦，不过要等到你们真正的家人之后才会一起庆祝。

say:18:1910337009:1.text: Tch, I thought we were already family after yesterday.
say:18:1910337009:1.source_cn: 啧，咱还以为昨天之后咱们就是家人了呢。

say:19:1910337010:1.text: We will be soon enough! You just need to go through the ceremony first!
say:19:1910337010:1.source_cn: 别着急呀，等你们参加完今天的洄游仪式，就是真正的家人了！

choice:5:1:2.text: I thought today was just a celebration!
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为今天只是个庆典仪式！
choice:5:1:2.male: I thought today was just a celebration!
choice:5:1:2.female: I thought today was just a celebration!
